bmail_mail_domains.description: Required. Comma-separated allowlist. A domain accepts any local part; a full address is exact. For example: mail.example.com,bbounty@programs.example.net

bmail_api_key.description: Required. Shared API key (bearer token) for the REST API. At least 16 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

bmail_forward_to.description: Optional. Forward every caught message to this address. Verify it first under Email Routing > Destination addresses, and do not route it back to this Worker. Enter `none` to disable forwarding.
